technical.title: SparseHPS enables sensor-agnostic 3D human pose and shape recovery
technical.summary: SparseHPS is a novel network that uses a single set of weights to recover SMPL-X pose, shape, and translation from human point clouds across both depth cameras and LiDAR sensors despite differing point densities.
technical.why: It unifies human pose and shape estimation across multiple sensor modalities for robotics and self-driving.

technical.title: UDA-Restoration algorithm improves autonomous vehicle semantic segmentation in adverse weather
technical.summary: UDA-Restoration is a diffusion-guided unsupervised domain adaptation algorithm using Noise-Space Domain Adaptation to enhance and denoise images, protecting autonomous driving perception systems from degradation due to weather and sensor noise.
technical.why: It directly improves vision-based perception reliability for autonomous vehicles under harsh environmental conditions.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Alpamayo 2 Edge reasoning VLA for DRIVE Thor
technical.summary: NVIDIA launched Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B-class reasoning vision-language-action model built to plan driving trajectories and explain them on DRIVE AGX Thor with low pixel-to-trajectory latency.
technical.why: It offers a cutting-edge edge AI model for autonomous driving trajectory planning.

technical.title: NoPeWorld framework prevents object penetration in interactive video world models
technical.summary: Researchers introduce NoPeBench and NoPeWorld to evaluate and prevent object penetration in interactive video world models, using the hidden states of diffusion transformers to predict and avoid physical obstacle violations.
technical.why: It provides a lightweight method to detect physical violations using existing diffusion transformer hidden states.

technical.title: Calibrated stereo vision provides explicit cross-view geometry for metric 3D reasoning
technical.summary: The study investigates how vision-language models can utilize calibrated stereo data to resolve metric 3D inference ambiguities, offering a more reliable foundation for perception and geometric generalization than single images.
technical.why: It addresses a core limitation of standard vision-language models regarding metric 3D spatial grounding.

technical.title: FoRe framework uses force feedback for autonomous grasp recovery in VLA models
technical.summary: Force-guided Recovery (FoRe) uses force feedback to partition demonstrations and autonomously recover from local grasping failures during pick-and-place tasks, overcoming the limitations of overreliance on proprioceptive cues.
technical.why: It enhances the autonomy and error-recovery capabilities of vision-language-action models in manipulation tasks.

technical.title: BeyondEgo framework combines egocentric and exocentric vision for humanoid loco-manipulation
technical.summary: BeyondEgo extends vision-language-action policies by encoding synchronized exocentric views with DINOv3 alongside egocentric tokens and utilizing future observations as privileged supervision for action experts.
technical.why: It improves spatial and temporal perception for humanoid robots performing complex loco-manipulation tasks.

technical.title: Meta introduces TLX to bring warp-group GPU control to Triton
technical.summary: Meta detailed Triton Low-Level Extensions (TLX), adding warp-group, barrier, TMA, and cluster control to Python Triton kernels to run ads and LLM workloads across Hopper, Blackwell, and AMD MI350 GPUs.
technical.why: It gives low-level hardware control to Python-based GPU kernel developers for advanced hardware architectures.

technical.title: NextUnit-Bench evaluates LLM coding agents for prognostics and health management tasks
technical.summary: This work examines shifting generality from models to modelers using NextUnit-Bench, a benchmark covering 24 public datasets. Frontier agents outperform traditional AutoML and published methods in delivering executable predictors for unseen equipment.
technical.why: It highlights how LLM agents can surpass AutoML in developing general solutions for unseen operational conditions.

technical.title: SCATR-ITS enables efficient individual tree segmentation from LiDAR point clouds
technical.summary: SCATR-ITS is a scalable transformer model built on ForestFormer3D that uses superpoint-level processing to accelerate inference, overcoming the computational limits of deep learning in large-scale forestry workflows.
technical.why: It offers an optimized transformer architecture for large-area LiDAR point cloud processing.

business.title: Nvidia Delivers Earnings Report Amid CEO Jensen Huang Scandal
business.summary: Nvidia delivered healthy growth earnings and promised continued success while halting H200 chip sales in China amidst its CEO ouster fallout.
business.why: Nvidia's market shifts and hardware export changes directly impact infrastructure availability for AI development.

business.title: Anthropic Raises $93.5 Billion Total in Record IPO
business.summary: The AI company sold an aggregate of 1,127,000,000 shares at $83 per share after underwriters scooped up the greenshoe overallotment.
business.why: This record-breaking IPO sets new valuation and public market benchmarks for foundational AI labs.

business.title: METR Report Finds AI Capabilities Improving Along Exponential Trajectory
business.summary: A new METR report reveals AI capabilities improve exponentially, though models remain less proficient at judgment tasks compared to coding.
business.why: Evaluating capability trajectories helps engineers anticipate realistic milestone timelines for model development.

business.title: Notable Capital, GIC, and Baillie Gifford Invest in Anthropic
business.summary: Three significant backers share what gave them conviction to bet billions on Anthropic before its IPO.
business.why: Understanding major institutional investor strategies helps track capital flows in the AI industry.

business.title: Walmart Implements Meta Muse for Automated Black Friday Shopping
business.summary: Walmart rolls out a live implementation of its Agent Gateway, letting Meta's Muse shop and find Black Friday deals on its website without sharing purchase history.
business.why: Consumer AI agent deployments indicate new commercial integration pathways for large language models.

business.title: Anthropic Goes Public on Nasdaq Following Record IPO
business.summary: The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday, prompting discussions on whether safety can remain a priority post-IPO.
business.why: Public market entry shifts governance and operational pressures for leading safety-focused AI labs.

business.title: Robot Startup Foundation Loses Health Benefits Amid Cash Crunch
business.summary: Foundation is pursuing an emergency bridge loan and talking with VC firms while waiting for a $150 million investment from South Korea's Base Group.
business.why: Monitoring startup financial instability highlights market risks and funding bottlenecks in hardware robotics.

business.title: ‘Worst COP ever’: Climate talks collapse after draft deal fails to include fossil fuels
business.summary: Governments and campaigners rejected the "cover decision" drafted at the U.N.'s climate summit, COP31, on Sunday.

business.title: Why data centers are at the center of the Big Tech backlash
business.summary: Journalist Paris Marx unpacks his new book "Hyperscale."

business.title: Science Leads Week's Funding Rounds With $400 Million
business.summary: U.S. startups secured sizable rounds, led by brain-computer interface company Science securing a fresh $400 million, alongside big deals in AI, fintech, and biotech.
business.why: Tracking venture capital funding reveals emerging sectors attracting major capital investments.

models.title: Apple Releases Depth Pro 2 for Metric Monocular Depth
models.summary: Depth Pro 2 estimates sharp, temporally consistent metric depth per pixel from an ordinary photo, video, or live feed at full resolution, accompanied by a focal length estimator.
models.why: Provides advanced monocular depth estimation with sharp object edges and steady frames for computer vision tasks.

models.title: New LoRA Adapter Optimizes Qwen3.8-27B for Coding Agents
models.summary: A reinforcement learning-trained LoRA adapter for Qwen3.8-27B matches high-effort thinking performance on software tasks while generating 4.5x fewer tokens.
models.why: Significantly improves coding agent efficiency and terminal task performance with fewer tokens.

models.title: Apple Releases FastFrames for Interactive Latency Video Generation
models.summary: FastFrames-S (1.3B) and FastFrames-L (14B) are autoregressive, two-step video diffusion models that generate 480p video at interactive latency.
models.why: Enables real-time, interactive video generation capabilities suitable for low-latency applications.

models.title: Inkling 2 Mini General-Purpose Multimodal Model Released
models.summary: Inkling 2 Mini is a general-purpose multimodal model accepting text and image inputs to generate text outputs. It supports multiple languages and coding tasks for developers building agentic systems and chatbots.
models.why: Provides developers with a new open-weight multimodal option for building tool-use and coding applications.

models.title: Tencent Releases Cost-Effective Hy4-Flash Multimodal Model
models.summary: Hy4 flash features 220B total parameters with 12B active parameters per token, natively accepting text and image inputs while focusing on cost-efficiency.
models.why: Offers a high-parameter multimodal model optimized for lower active computation costs.

models.title: Haru-4B Introduces Low-Latency Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Model
models.summary: Haru-4B is a low-latency, multilingual full-duplex continuous spoken dialogue foundation model that listens and speaks simultaneously at 7.5 Hz using a 64-dimensional latent per frame.
models.why: Pioneers native full-duplex conversational audio architectures where listening and speaking overlap.
